content: Yɛsu kusà a Pilatu
Yàmɛnà naa un'kàbɔ a baar wanswà kàkyer ambarà, waa kàsyen Yɛsu kusà a Pilatu.
Akun, ba bàsɛmà mukun'füün abà: « Bi kan'man mbuur wà wàmutwaal lingyoomà uboo a un'sɛŋ abi: Nde akatsuŋà baar mufur itɛr akà Sɛzar, nde kan'tɛn sye naa nde wà Klistɔ, mfum! »
Apan Pilatu kun'fuul naa: « Nkye ngye awà mfum a Ayudà? » Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: « Ngye ŋakwo an'tɛn. »
Pilatu kàtɛn a amfum a angaŋ anà un'kàbɔ a baar naa: « Mɛ in'manà anki undiir kan'kwo mɛ mupà mbuur wà ikwàndwà. »
Wɛɛ ba bàsi unkiiŋ mutɛn naa: « Nde ayimbaar baar mukyer ube unsà an'lɔɔŋ ande u Yuday lanswà sɛmà u Ngalilɛ tii apà. »
Mpal kàwem Pilatu ndaa ayi, nde kafuul naa nkye mbuur awà wà un'nsi Ngalilɛ.
Umpal kàyöb nde naa nde wà mbuur a ikal ufàyaal Ɛlɔdi, nde kun'töm akà Ɛlɔdi. Taaŋ nsil alan Ɛlɔdi kàkäl u Yɛlusàlɛm.
Ɛlɔdi kàkäl unsà un'sak mbɔɔn muman Yɛsu, ntɔn sɛmà itaan nde kàkwen mukun'man, ntɔn yinà kàweemà nde, nde kàleŋà naa nde utàman akà impà mwɛy.
Nde kun'si mfuul mbɔɔn, wɛɛ Yɛsu kàsàfuur anki akà ikikye.
Taaŋ nsil alan, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàmbärà paa, bàmukun'füünà a nkyɛl.
Apan, Ɛlɔdi anà aŋità ande bun'mɛn asànaa undiir a bunàbun, waa bun'sɛɛ, bun'bwää inkur aŋàbwaŋ. Ɛlɔdi kun'fuur akà Pilatu.
Ɛlɔdi anà Pilatu bàkäl ayiiŋ, wɛɛ sɛmà ilä akin ba bàbulà asam.
Yɛsu bàmutsüül mbar a ukwà
Abun, Pilatu kàbel amfum a angaŋ, abyääl anà un'sɛŋ,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Bɛ lan'twääl mbuur wà naa nde wàmubuul an'kyän a un'sɛŋ. Wɛ mɛ, mɛ amun'fuul u mii abɛ, mɛ in'sàman anki undiir kan'kyer nde uboo a indiir byanswà lun'füünà bɛ.
Ɛlɔdi sye usàman anki ube ande, lalan kàman'fuur nde awà. Abun, mbuur wà undiir ukyer nde watɛy awà ban'kwo mukun'dwa.
Mɛ in'swaŋ baar amɛ bun'käm an'füm, waa mɛ un'wɛy. »
Kà un'kyɔm a Pak wanswà Pilatu kàkäl anà nkääl mukatsuuŋ mbuur a bɔlokà mwɛy.
Wɛɛ un'sɛŋ wanswà kàsɛmà musà in'kwɛŋ: « Idwääl mbuur wà! Un'tsuuŋ Barabas! »
Barabas awà bun'si ba u bɔlokà ntɔn lingyoomà làbü uboo a bul anà nde sye kàdwä mbuur.
Wɛ Pilatu kàkwen muwɛy Yɛsu, waa kàfàtɛn mbalà asin a ba,
wɛɛ ba bàkuub in'kwɛŋ, waa bàtɛn naa: « Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! Un'bɛɛrà u kulunsi! »
Wɛɛ nde kàfafuul mbalà yàtär: « Ube nà nde kan'kyer? Mɛ in'sàman anki akà ube mwɛy ntɔn nde ukwe mukwà. Abun, mɛ in'pà mbwo naa bun'pɛ an'füm waa mɛ un'wɛy. »
Wɛɛ ba bàsi unkiiŋ u ndaa a ngwal naa bun'bɛɛrà u kulunsi. In'kwɛŋ aba myàwɛl iböŋ.
Lalan Pilatu kàyer akyey nde ndɔ̈ɔ̈m aba.
Nde kàtsuuŋ mbuur kàbilà bɔlokà ntɔn lingyoomà anà nkweel a mbuur mwɛy, waa kapɛ Yɛsu ntɔn ba bun'kyer undiir bàkweenà ba.
Yɛsu bàmubɛɛrà u kulunsi
Wɛɛ mpal bàkäl ba mukun'syen, ba bàbweey anà mbuur mwɛy kàkäl u mbwo kàfü nde itsuŋ a ndwà, ikɔb ande Simɔn un'nsi Sirɛn, ba bun'siinà a ngwal mubay Yɛsu musyen kulunsi ungö.
Un'kàbɔ a baar kàkäl muyilab. Akaar sye bàkäl mbɔɔn muyilel anà muman ntaan ntɔn nde.
Yɛsu kàbulà ntsü akà ba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Akaar a Yɛlusàlɛm, twon lan'lel ntɔn mɛ! Làlel ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo anà baan abɛ,
ntɔn le, làyöb naa ilä iyàyà bàyàtɛn naa: "Un'sak akà akaar ikɔb anà akaar mpa bàbör anà mpa bànüü baan."
Apan baar bàsàbulà mutɛn a myɔŋ a bwɛlàbwɛl naa: "Làbü udu a bi!" A myɔŋ a ikökö: "Lifwee!"
Ntɔn isàkal naa un'te a un'bu bàmukyer abà, ya isàkal aben ntɔn un'te aŋàyɔm? »
Yàmɛnà sye naa ba bàsyen, mbwo mwɛy anà Yɛsu, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàfakyerà baar ube, ntɔn bàkadwa sye.
Mpal bàtöl ba kà ikal mwɛy ikɔb akya « Bɔl a un'tswe », ba bàbɛɛrà Yɛsu u kulunsi anà baar bööl abà, umwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ibaal, wumwɛy u kɔɔ ande là ikaar.
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Taa, adwääl nkul, ntɔn ba bàyöb anki ndaa bàkyerà ba. » Ba bàkäb ipfɛy ande mutà löb.
Un'sɛŋ kàkäl paa muleerà. Wɛɛ abyääl bàkäl musɛɛ nde, waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Nde kàtsü baar asin mɔ̈ɔ̈, wɛy nde utsü mɔ̈ɔ̈ nde ŋakwo isàkal naa nde wà Klistɔ, mbuur kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l Nzam. »
Aŋità sye bàkäl mukun'sɛɛ. Ba bàsin tsütsü apà nde, waa bun'pɛɛ man a nkyään,
waa bàtɛɛnà naa: « Isàkal naa ngye awà mfum a Ayudà, tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ngye ŋakwo. »
Udu a nde yàkäl anà ndaa aŋàsɔn abà: « Mbuur wà, wà mfum a Ayudà. »
Umwɛy uboo a baar abe bàkäl u kulunsi waa kun'töö, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Nkye ngye kà Klistɔ anki? Tswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ngye ŋakwo anà bi mwo sye. »
Wɛɛ wumwɛy waa kun'pɛl, kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ngye Nzam bɔɔmà un'tiin anki, ngye mbuur an'wal ntaaŋàmbar nsil ya?
Akà bi, bi ube abi kan'fur, wɛ nde undiir ube ukyer nde watɛy. »
Waa kàkwɛy naa: « Yɛsu, ngyɔbà mpal asàyà ngye kà imwol angye. »
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: « Mɛ ndandaa akyään, ŋabawà ngye akal u du anà mɛ. »
Sɛmà tsütsü a taaŋ a midi tii taaŋ làtär ungö a midi làpib làkyer abwà u nsi yanswà.
Taaŋ làkäl lan'minà, rido a kölàköl làkäl uboo a ndwà a Nzam làkyer akaamà u boboo.
Apan Yɛsu kàsi in'kwɛŋ waa kàtɛn naa: « Taa, mɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ amɛ an'fuur akà ngye. » Ungö mutɛn ndaa ayi, laa kàkü nde.
Muman ndaa yàlyaaŋ yi, kaptɛn a Lɔmà kàsi Nzam làkoo anà kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa mbuur wà kàkäl mbuur a balàbal. »
Ungö apan, in'kàbɔ a baar myanswà myàyi muyàler ibaŋ a ndaa aki, bàfurà bàmuyibɛɛrà kà itɔl.
Asam a Yɛsu banswà anà akaar bàyilabà nde sɛmà Ngalilɛ, bàmbärà ukwɛl mulerà ndaa yàlyaaŋà.
Yɛsu bàmusà kà an'dii
Yàmɛnà naa kàkäl anà mbuur mwɛy ikɔb ande Yɔsɛfi, nde kàkäl mbuur a làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl, mbuur aŋàbwaŋ anà wàbalàbal.
Nde kàkäl anki un'sak anà atɔŋ ande baar a Làbay a Nsaŋ a kölàköl ntɔn ayà bàtsül ba anà bàkyer ba. Nde kàkäl mbuur a bul a Yuday ikɔb la Arimatay, waa kàdilà ngyeel a Imwol a Nzam.
Nde kàkàlɔm ndür a Yɛsu akà Pilatu.
Ungö mutɔl ya u kulunsi, nde kàläl ya uboo a làpye a ntal, waa kàsi ya kà an'dii akün bàfuun uboo a nkɔŋ anà mpa aŋàtàsà mbuur.
Kya kyàkäl ilä muyöŋà ntɔn saba làkäl tsütsü musɛmà.
Akaar bàläbà Yɛsu sɛmà Ngalilɛ bàläb Yɔsɛfi. Ba bàleerà an'dii anà muyöb naa ba ndür a Yɛsu bàtɔl aben.
Ungö, bàfurà ba ndwà aba, ba bàyilà may a usɔŋ anà an'nanàsi. Apan waa bàkyɛɛl saba asànaa Un'kɔɔn utɛɛnà wa.
